commit_subject: Phase 11: only two layers do anything — 3B on detection, 3C on workflow continuation, and four components at 0/0 with zero discordant pairs

external_benign.citation: Debenedetti et al., AgentDojo, NeurIPS D&B 2024

injecagent.citation: Zhan et al., InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated Large Language Model Agents, Findings of ACL 2024
injecagent.excluded: data-stealing split (two-step exfiltration this single-boundary pipeline cannot model) and both `enhanced` splits (they prepend a hand-written hijack prompt, which makes them EASIER)
injecagent.pooling: STRATA MUST NOT BE POOLED. Drawn 30/30 from a 51/459 population, so a pooled rate over this sample over-weights the target-match stratum ~9x and would flatter the detector.

seeding: greedy decoding at temperature 0; no RNG seed is exposed by Ollama. Not literally deterministic (§6n: 2/564 regime severities disagreed).

replay.note: fully_replayed=true means every case came from logs/phase12_cp; the commit below describes the ANALYSIS, not the model runs that produced these outcomes.
